Your Spanish verbs note now has a flashcard page. Open the note and choose **Page** to see it. I haven't opened it on a phone myself, so I can't say how it looks there.

- **Flipping:** Tap a card to flip it between the Spanish verb and its English meaning. All 12 verbs from your table are included.
- **Marking cards:** Tap **I know it** or **Again**. Verbs you mark as known are saved with the date, so they're still marked next time you open the note.
- **Order:** Cards you haven't marked as known come first. Once you know them all, it shows "all done".
- **Extras:** A progress bar shows how many you know. An "All cards" list shows which ones are marked as known, and it has a **Start over** button.

The note's table is unchanged. If you add verbs to it, they show up as new cards.
